name: context-meter
description: Context-window usage at the bottom right of Claude Code, next to the sub-meter bar: tokens used, a bar, and a color that says when to /compact.

warnTokensK.title: Yellow at (thousands of tokens)
warnTokensK.description: The meter turns yellow once the context holds this many thousand tokens. On a model whose window is not larger, the same share of the window is used instead.

criticalTokensK.title: Red at (thousands of tokens)
criticalTokensK.description: The meter turns red, and a toast suggests /compact, once the context holds this many thousand tokens. On a model whose window is not larger, the same share of the window is used instead.

showToast.title: Toast when the context turns red
showToast.description: Show a toast once each time the context enters red.

toastLanguage.title: Toast language
toastLanguage.description: Language of the toast: es for Spanish, en for English.

showMarker.title: Auto-compact marker on the bar
showMarker.description: Mark the bar cell where auto-compact will run. Hidden when auto-compact is off.
